sourceEvidence.quote: The cheapest model call can produce the most expensive workflow if it creates ambiguity that requires repeated repair.
A system can be general at the level of problem interpretation while remaining narrow at the level of action.
MRP-VM instead represents long-running work through named executable knowledge objects and explicit intermediate values, while conversation remains one interface rather than the whole machine.
